content.title: 时态(复习 + 过去将来时)速查
content.intro: 选时态先找“时间信号”:时间状语(now / yesterday / since / by the time）和语境决定唯一答案。过去将来时是难点:站在过去某个时点往后看,用 would do 或 was/were going to do。

headers: 标志 / 用法 / 例句
rows: every day / usually / 客观事实:Our library opens early every weekday.
now / Look! / Listen! / at the moment:Listen! Someone is delivering a speech.
yesterday / last term / ago:Last term the teacher gave us an assignment.
at this time yesterday / when ...(从句一般过去):I was thinking about school at this time yesterday.
already / since / so far / for + 时间段:I have made three new friends so far.
by the time + 过去 / before + 过去(更早动作):By the time she arrived, the teacher had left.
said/hoped/thought + would do;过去的打算 = was/were going to do:He said he would beg the teacher.

specialRules.rule: 主句过去 → 宾语从句时态相应后移(现在→过去、将来→过去将来)
specialRules.mark: She said she WAS going to like it.

specialRules.rule: by the time + 一般过去,主句用过去完成(had done)
specialRules.mark: By last Friday we HAD chosen the topic.

specialRules.rule: since + 过去时间点 / 过去动作,主句用现在完成
specialRules.mark: Since the term began, I HAVE felt happier.

specialRules.rule: would do 与 was/were going to do 都表“过去将来”,后者更强调当时的打算
specialRules.mark: I was going to send you a message.

why: 时态的本质是“说话视角的时间点 + 动作相对它的先后/状态”;过去将来就是把视角放回过去,再往后看,所以 will→would、am going to→was going to。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:由 since / by the time / when 等连接词判断主从句时态搭配。
宾语从句时态呼应:主句过去时,从句须相应后移(would / had done / was doing)。
区分 had done(过去的过去)与 would do(过去将来)——看动作发生在“过去时点”之前还是之后。

examVsReal.exam: He said he would come.（考试用过去将来 would）
examVsReal.note: 口语里转述很近的将来常直接保留 will;考试默认时态呼应,用 would

examVsReal.exam: By the time I arrived, the class had started.（考试用 had done）
examVsReal.real: When I got there, class already started.
examVsReal.note: 口语常用一般过去 + already 代替过去完成;书面/考试讲究 had done
